themes.description: This theme covers requests or complaints related to trading tools, indicators, charting capabilities, and other features essential for trading activities.
This theme covers issues related to the initial account creation, onboarding process, KYC verification, and other steps required to set up an account.
Covers ease of use, intuitive interface, and overall user experience.
Covers feedback, requests, or comparisons related to specific product functionalities and offerings.
This theme covers reviews where users complain about the app directly causing financial losses or poor investment results, without specifying a technical bug or fee issue.
This theme includes suggestions for new functionalities, enhancements to existing features, or requests for additional options within the application.
This theme covers issues related to account setup, KYC, document verification, and other processes required to activate or maintain an account.
Issues related to account creation, verification, activation, and initial setup processes.
This theme covers feedback related to the overall ease of use, design, and general user experience of the application.
This theme includes feedback on the clarity, availability, and helpfulness of information and guidance provided for various investment products.
This theme covers feedback and requests related to the availability and features of specific financial products like loans, insurance, or other investment instruments.
This theme covers complaints about the range of available investment products, market access, or specific asset classes not supported by the platform.
This theme covers user requests for new features or complaints about the absence of specific functionalities within the application.
General feedback about the overall application experience, design, or user satisfaction.
This theme covers issues related to the delayed or inaccurate updating of financial data, such as portfolio values or transaction statuses.
This theme covers user suggestions for improving the app's user interface, layout, or the presentation of information.
This theme covers problems or limitations related to the app's user interface, display, and overall user experience, including adaptability to different screen orientations.
This theme covers suggestions for new features, improvements to existing app functionalities, and general feedback on the user interface and experience.
Issues related to application design, user interface, and user experience that lead to confusion or unintended actions.
Complaints about missing features, limited functionality, or comparisons to competitor offerings.
Requests for new features, integrations, or enhancements to existing functionality within the application.
Feedback on the app's ease of use, user-friendliness, and overall user experience.
Overall positive feedback or general satisfaction with the application without specific details.
Comments or requests related to specific features, updates, or functionality of the application.
Feedback related to the app's ability to keep users interested, engaged, or entertained.
Covers general complaints about the overall quality, reliability, or outdated nature of the application, impacting the user experience.

Covers feedback on the application's user interface, ease of use, navigation, and overall design elements like font size or complexity.
